parameters.help_en:
The names of the SQL throttling rules to delete. To delete multiple rules in a batch, separate the rule names with commas (,).

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html operation to view the details of all SQL throttling rules for the target cluster, including their names
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的SQL限流规则名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量删除，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html接口查看目标集群下所有SQL限流规则规则的详情，包括规则名称
